entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

O Mungu wami, isoɛnɛ mbo okelimi eoka iluweke la iinelek’ Aɛ. Iswimela nda eye mbileye bowandu wami la bofoka w’ Aɛ; iuw’ami la lifoka liaɛ. Angoɛnɛ Mungu wasi sakoloko Aɛ, oyo atosungaka nda mbile ya tale, oyo ayali laya laya.
